findings.claim: The new projection runtime uses `Arc<dyn EntityStore>`, but `EntityStore` contains `async fn` methods and is not dyn-compatible, so the workspace will not compile.
findings.evidence: The diff adds `pub store: Arc<dyn EntityStore>` and `let store: Arc<dyn EntityStore> = projection;` in `crates/frf-gateway/src/entity_projection_runtime.rs`, while `crates/frf-ports/src/entity_store.rs` defines `pub trait EntityStore` with async methods such as `async fn get_entity`, `async fn watch_entity`, `async fn apply_projection`, `async fn install_projection_snapshot`, and `async fn projection_checkpoint`; constraint R1 requires `cargo check --workspace` to be clean.
findings.suggested_fix: Make `EntityStore` object-safe, e.g. apply `#[async_trait::async_trait]` to the trait definition as well as its impls, or avoid `dyn EntityStore` by keeping the store type concrete/generic through gateway composition.
